description: React functional component 'NotesList' for displaying, searching, pagination, and deleting notes in a note-taking application. It manages local state, fetches data from API services, and renders UI with loading skeletons and note items.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: React functional component that displays a list of notes with search, pagination, and delete functionality.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches notes from the API based on current page, page size, and search parameters.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a note after user confirmation, then refreshes the list.
